name: v0.0.79
body:
### Fixed: denies that did not apply

- **Names with glob characters** (`[wip] app`, `br[1]`), all platforms. A path entry whose characters read as a pattern is now also read as the path it spells, where that exists. Before, a deny through such a folder matched nothing. (#620, #622; #134, #576)
- **Linux, dangerous names in subdirectories.** `.bashrc`, `.git/config`, `.vscode/` and the like are write-denied one level below the working directory whatever else the tree holds, and a folder the scan cannot read is denied whole. (#629)

### Faster, and off the caller's thread (Linux)

- Expanding `denyRead` and `allowRead` patterns is about six times faster and uses less memory: six `**` rules over 400,000 files, 6.3 s to 1.0 s. The rules of one configuration share their directory listings. (#627)
- The expansion gives the event loop a turn every 10 ms, and stops when the `AbortSignal` passed to `wrapWithSandbox()` is aborted. (#628)
- A wrap goes by one configuration and one working directory. If `updateConfig()`, `initialize()` or `chdir()` runs while a command is being wrapped, the wrap starts over and reads the disk again. After two restarts it finishes its walk without yielding. (#638, #644, #655)
- A directory that cannot be listed is tried once per wrap, not once per rule, and the read lists hold each path once. 100 rules over 50 such directories on a slow mount: 72 s to 2.5 s, the same sandbox. (#645)

### Fixed: other

- **Linux:** a sandboxed command's first network call was sometimes refused, because the command could start before the in-sandbox relays listened. It now starts once both do. (#639; #616)
- **Network:** an upstream that answered with an invalid status line or header made the HTTP proxy throw, which ended the process running it. The proxy now answers `502 Bad Gateway`. (#660)
- **CLI:** a binary built with `bun build --compile` starts again. It failed with `Cannot find module '../package.json'`. (#630)
- **bubblewrap 0.4** starts again: one mount per destination. (#580)

### New

- `{ path, literal: true }` in any of the four `filesystem` path lists marks an entry as a name, whatever characters it holds. (#621)

### For whoever upgrades

- **Types (breaking at compile time):** the four `filesystem` path lists are `FilesystemPathEntry[]`, that is `string | { path: string; literal: true }`, where they were `string[]`. `writeRootsOf()` gives every write root. (#621)
- **Node:** `engines` is `>=22.12.0`. (#636)


## What's Changed
* linux: make the read-deny glob walk about six times faster by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/627
* linux: the wrap walks its patterns in turns, and stops when its signal is aborted by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/628
* linux: deny every dangerous name of a subdirectory, not only those three levels down by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/629
* Raise the supported Node floor to 22.12, and move CI to Node 22 by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/636
* linux: one mount per destination, so bubblewrap 0.4 starts by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/580
* linux: a wrap that starts over keeps what it has walked, and ends by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/638
* linux: a wrap that starts over reads the disk again by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/644
* Glob walk: an `anchor` option, a directory taken as the name it is by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/620
* Let a caller mark a path entry literal: `{ path, literal: true }` by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/621
* Read a path entry as the path it spells, where that exists by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/622
* linux: try a directory that cannot be listed once, and give each path once by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/645
* ci: run the Docker legs on Node 22, not on the image's Node 18 by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/643
* linux: a command starts once both relays listen by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/639
* linux: one wrap, one working directory, and no object taken for the same install by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/655
* cli: read the version through a static import, so a compiled binary starts by @TurtIeSocks in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/630
* Answer 502 when an upstream sends an invalid status code by @ant-kurt in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/660
* Release v0.0.79 by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/637

## New Contributors
* @TurtIeSocks made their first contribution in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/630

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/compare/v0.0.78...v0.0.79
